description: Unique user identifier in U-prefixed zero-padded format (U0001 to U0200).
Title of the movie being rated, drawn from a curated pool of 80+ Indian and international films.
Genre category of the movie. One of: Action, Drama, Comedy, Thriller, Romance, Sci-Fi, Crime, Animation.
Language of the movie version rated. One of: Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Bengali, Marathi, English, Korean, Japanese.
Year the movie was released, ranging from 1955 to 2023.
User rating on a 1.0 to 5.0 scale in 0.5 increments. Follows a bell-curve distribution centred around 3.5; anomaly rows have forced extreme values (1.0 or 5.0).
Date and time when the rating was submitted, in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format, between 2023-01-01 and 2025-12-31.
Binary flag indicating whether the rating is an anomaly (simulated bot/noise). 1 = anomaly, 0 = normal. Approximately 2-5 % of rows are anomalies.
